title: Netherite Star
description: This resource pack changes The Nether Star to be made of Netherite
body:
A simple resource pack that redesigns the Nether Star with a Netherite-inspired look.

The star now features dark metallic tones and a forged Netherite style, making it feel like a true reward from defeating the Wither.

Features
Netherite-themed Nether Star texture
Vanilla-friendly design

Perfect for players who want the Nether Star to match Minecraft's strongest material.

Made by HotwheelHedgehog.
